title: Greeting, Guard the Deposit Entrusted to You

questions.question: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God according to the promise of the ____ that is in Christ Jesus,
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:1 (ESV): "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God according to the promise of the life that is in Christ Jesus,"

questions.question: Paul writes to Timothy, his beloved ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:2 (ESV): "To Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord."

questions.question: Paul thanks God, whom he serves with a clear ____, as his ancestors did.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:3 (ESV): "I thank God whom I serve, as did my ancestors, with a clear conscience, as I remember you constantly in my prayers night and day."

questions.question: Paul remembers Timothy's tears, and longs to see him, that he may be filled with ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:4 (ESV): "As I remember your tears, I long to see you, that I may be filled with joy."

questions.question: Paul is reminded of Timothy's sincere faith, a faith that dwelt first in his grandmother Lois and his mother ____.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:5 (ESV): "I am reminded of your sincere faith, a faith that dwelt first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and now, I am sure, dwells in you as well."

questions.question: Paul reminds Timothy to fan into flame the ____ of God, which is in him through the laying on of Paul's hands.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:6 (ESV): "For this reason I remind you to fan into flame the gift of God, which is in you through the laying on of my hands,"

questions.question: For God gave us a spirit not of fear but of ____ and love and self-control.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:7 (ESV): "for God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control."

questions.question: Therefore do not be ____ of the testimony about our Lord, nor of me his prisoner...
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:8 (ESV): "Therefore do not be ashamed of the testimony about our Lord, nor of me his prisoner, but share in suffering for the gospel by the power of God,"

questions.question: God saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works but because of his own purpose and ____,
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:9 (ESV): "who saved us and called us to a holy calling, not because of our works but because of his own purpose and grace, which he gave us in Christ Jesus before the ages began,"

questions.question: Our Savior Christ Jesus abolished death and brought ____ and immortality to light through the gospel,
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:10 (ESV): "and which now has been manifested through the appearing of our Savior Christ Jesus, who abolished death and brought life and immortality to light through the gospel,"

questions.question: Paul says, "But I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard until that day what has been ____ to me."
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:12 (ESV): "But I am not ashamed, for I know whom I have believed, and I am convinced that he is able to guard until that day what has been entrusted to me."

questions.question: Follow the pattern of the ____ words that you have heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:13 (ESV): "Follow the pattern of the sound words that you have heard from me, in the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus."

questions.question: By the Holy Spirit who dwells within us, guard the good ____ entrusted to you.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:14 (ESV): "By the Holy Spirit who dwells within us, guard the good deposit entrusted to you."

questions.question: Paul mentions that all who are in ____ turned away from him, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:15 (ESV): "You are aware that all who are in Asia turned away from me, among whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes."

questions.question: May the Lord grant mercy to the household of ____, for he often refreshed Paul and was not ashamed of his chains.
questions.explanation: 2 Timothy 1:16 (ESV): "May the Lord grant mercy to the household of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me and was not ashamed of my chains,"

key_verse_text: for God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control.
